The Special Public Meeting of the Glendale City Council convened in the City Hall Council
Chambers, in said City, at 6:02 p.m. on the above date, pursuant to a call for such meeting
signed by the City Clerk of the City Council, and on file with the City Clerk, a copy of which is as
follows:
  September 27, 2023
  Date
A SPECIAL PUBLIC MEETING of the City Council is hereby called to meet at 6:00 PM on
Tuesday, October 3, 2023, in the Sparr Heights Community Center at 1613 Glencoe Way,
Glendale, CA 91208 to consider the following item(s) of business, to wit;

1. ITEMS FOR DISCUSSION:
  a. Pay By Phone Parking Program
  b. Organics Waste Recycling Program

  b. Low Income Programs

 Written Notice of said meeting was given, which Notice consisted of a copy of the
 foregoing Call, and was served on each Member of the Council not joining in the Call,
